name: ai-usage-meter
description: Session Pilot (formerly the AI Usage Meter mod): your 5-hour, weekly and context figures in a band above the prompt and a /meter pane, with session-notes warnings; works with or without the AI Usage Meter strip (unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic)

useStripSettings.title: Use the strip's Settings when it is installed
useStripSettings.description: On: when the AI Usage Meter strip is installed, its Settings window decides the levels, colours and notifications, and the values below are not used. Off: the values below always apply.

warn1.title: Limits: first warning (%)
warn1.description: Session (5-hour) and Week turn orange, with a message, from this percentage.

warn2.title: Limits: second warning (%)
warn2.description: Session (5-hour) and Week turn red, with a message, from this percentage.

sessLevel1.title: Context: yellow from (% of compaction)
sessLevel1.description: Compress turns yellow and asks you to finish the task and update your session notes.

sessLevel2.title: Context: red from (% of compaction)
sessLevel2.description: Compress turns red and asks you to start a new session. Must be higher than the yellow level.

notify.title: Message at the limit warnings
notify.description: A short message inside Claude Code when Session or Week reaches a warning level.

notifyReset.title: Message when a limit resets
notifyReset.description: A short message when the 5-hour or weekly limit has reset.

notifyCompaction.title: Message when compaction has run
notifyCompaction.description: A short message reminding you to check paths, rules and decisions after compaction.

blink.title: Blink at red
blink.description: At the red context level, the Compress figure and the "start a new session" line blink until the context drops back.

robot.title: Little robot in the band
robot.description: A small pixel robot beside Details: it blinks, scans while Claude works, its antenna shows the Compress colour, and it cheers when Close session says it is safe. In the terminal it is a short text face.

robotPerModel.title: Robot: a different robot for each model
robotPerModel.description: On: the robot shows the model in use: Opus (crown), Sonnet (ears), Haiku (short antenna), Fable (two antenna points). Off: always the same robot.

robotEffort.title: Robot: show the effort level
robotEffort.description: On: five lights on the robot's chest show the effort (low = 1 light … max = 5), and its eyes scan faster at a higher level. A model without effort levels shows no lights.

tokenYellow.title: Context: yellow from (tokens)
tokenYellow.description: Also warn yellow (finish the task, update your notes) when the conversation holds this many tokens, whatever the %. With a 1M window the % levels come late; 250000 is a good start. 0 = off.

tokenRed.title: Context: red from (tokens)
tokenRed.description: Also warn red (start a new session) from this many tokens, for example 350000. 0 = off.

cacheClock.title: Cache clock
cacheClock.description: Show how long the conversation's cache stays warm after Claude's last reply, with a Keep warm button in the /meter pane.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache clock: cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: 60 on a Claude plan (Pro, Max) in Claude Code; 5 with an API key.

exploreOnHaiku.title: Search helpers (Explore) on Haiku
exploreOnHaiku.description: Start Claude Code's read-only search helper on Haiku instead of the session's model. Other helpers keep their model. Off by default.

readerMode.title: Haiku reader
readerMode.description: off: Opus reads everything. search: when Opus reads a lot in one turn, it gives further reading to a reader on Haiku, which finds files and lines; Opus reads those lines itself. summary: the reader also gives a short summary (for questions, not for code changes). The pane's On/Off switch overrides this per PC.

readerThreshold.title: Haiku reader: from (tokens read in one turn)
readerThreshold.description: When Opus reads more than this in one turn, it is asked once to give further reading to the Haiku reader. At least 500.

htmlCompanion.title: HTML companion
htmlCompanion.description: After Claude writes a long Markdown document worth re-reading (a plan, a spec, a comparison), offer an HTML version with a table of contents and diagrams. ask: offer it, make it only on a yes. on: make it by itself. off: never. The Markdown stays the source of truth.

robotSize.title: Robot size
robotSize.description: 2 = small, 3 = medium, 4 = large (screen pixels per robot pixel). Bigger makes the band's top row taller.

staleMinutes.title: Figures are old after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: After this many minutes without new figures, the limits are dimmed and the band says how old they are (10 to 1440).
